I stopped before making any changes. The skill only runs on a project that already has `_codev/config.yaml`, and this one doesn't.

This project has no `_codev/`. Run `codev init` first, then come back to `/codev-configure`.

I checked with `codev status --json`, which returned `no_codev_root`. The project root contains only `README.md`, `index.js`, `package.json` and `.claude/`. The skill never creates the config itself, so I didn't explore the project, draft a patch or ask for confirmation.
